findings.title: Ungated email_search IMAP SEARCH-criteria CR/LF injection → mailbox STORE/CREATE/EXPUNGE
evidence: risk.py:39-53 classify → READ; permissions.py:131-133 always allow
tools/registry.py:62-66 execute has no type/sanitize layer
Wire PoC: SEARCH line splits; injected A9 UID STORE / CREATE / EXPUNGE appear as separate IMAP commands
findings.attack_path: 1. Attacker prompt-injects a session with email connected (Slack mention, malicious mail/page the agent reads, etc.). 2. Model calls email_search(from_address|subject|text|to_address) containing CR/LF + a second IMAP command (e.g. UID STORE … +FLAGS (\Deleted)). 3. Tool is kind=read → RiskClass.READ → no approval. 4. build_search_criteria/_quote embeds the CRLF inside a quoted term. 5. imaplib sends a multi-line command; the IMAP server executes the injected STORE/CREATE/EXPUNGE. 6. Impact: silent mailbox mutation under a "read" tool.
findings.distinctness: Not UID-parameter CR/LF (email_read/_fetch_message). Not SELECT folder _quote injection. Sink is SEARCH criteria fields on ungated email_search.
findings.doubts: Requires email connector connected and a reachable IMAP server that accepts pipelined/injected commands after a broken quoted string (common for imaplib raw CRLF splits).
